title: Return on investment
statementMd:
For movies with known budget and gross, show the title and the gross-to-budget ratio rounded to 1 decimal. Highest ratio first.

Expected columns: `title`, `roi`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, ROUND(gross_millions / budget_millions, 1) AS roi FROM movies WHERE budget_millions IS NOT NULL AND gross_millions IS NOT NULL ORDER BY roi DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
